blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cases of animal neglect that have recently drawn public attention — from the abandonment of pet remains entrusted to crematoriums to recurring incidents of animal abuse — underscore the need to strengthen the country’s animal welfare mechanisms. This was the assessment of Dr. Alicor Panao, an Inquirer data scientist and associate professor at the University of the Philippines, who said recent reports that shocked the public have renewed concerns over how the government protects animals, including pets increasingly regarded as members of the family. “These incidents bring into focus the need to strengthen the country’s animal welfare framework, […]...
